svg.title: McLaren Vale (SA) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: McLaren Vale; 2: Clarendon; 3: McLaren Flat; 4: Seaview; 5: Willunga; 6: Reynella; 7: Currency Creek; 8: Halletts Cove; 9: Hackham West; 10: Adelaide; 11: Victor Harbor

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
